title: pastOutreachEvents
description: Schema for a document in the 'pastOutreachEvents' collection. Archived outreach events (same structure as outreachEvents).

uid.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the organizer who created the event.

title.description: The public title of the outreach event.

description.description: A detailed description of the event's purpose and activities.

helpType.description: The category of help being provided.

status.description: The current status of the event.

approved.description: Whether the event has been officially approved.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the event was created. Represents a Firestore Timestamp.

eventDate.description: The general date of the event. Represents a Firestore Timestamp.

eventStartTime.description: The specific start time of the event. Represents a Firestore Timestamp.

eventEndTime.description: The specific end time of the event. Represents a Firestore Timestamp.

totalSlots.description: The maximum number of volunteer slots available.

interests.description: Counter tracking how many users have expressed interest.

participants.description: List of UIDs of users who signed up or participated.

skills.description: List of skills required for the event.

location.description: The physical location where the event will take place.
